data.title: [The Hearth Fire Beckons the Starry Flow] Chartered Headhunting
data.data:
Dear Endministrator, 
During [The Hearth Fire Beckons the Starry Flow] Chartered Headhunting, the 6★ operator [Argent Flow] is Rate-UP! 
[The Stars Are With Me] limited-time sign-in event will open simultaneously. Accumulate sign-ins to earn rewards such as [The Stars Are With Me HH Permit]×5. You can also exchange for [The Stars Are With Me HH Permit] at a discount in [AIC Quota Exchange]. The [Combat Drills] operator trial event will also be available during this period.

· Availability: Nov. 5, 2026 at 12:00 (server time) – Before version update and maintenance 

· Participation Criteria: Complete the main mission [Chapter I Process I: Break the Siege]
